scientific_integrity.limitations: Not a global convergence, permanence, basin, or stability theorem. Some initial states may remain physical when the global conditions fail. Parameter restriction epsilon <= 1 is essential to edge reduction. Independent external verification is not available.
scientific_integrity.priority_risk: A differently indexed or specialized theorem could cover the self-review; identified references do not imply these sharp inequalities.
scientific_integrity.proved: Complete necessary and sufficient inward-pointing criteria for the entire nonnegative habitat simplex, under the explicitly stated 2023 source equations and epsilon in (0,1].
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: Standalone exact-rational verifier supplied; 5000 parameter instances and 330000 boundary grid points evaluated. The proof is symbolic.

title: Sharp global viability thresholds in a free-space predator–prey–parasite model
